name: kong-cost-rpm
description: Test 3 on Kong OSS 3.9.3, run through run-cost.sh with a throwaway consumer (its limit in the run's meta.json note). Kong's rate-limiting plugin on the consumer: 3 requests a minute, policy local (counted in the instance's memory; windows are clock minutes, and run-cost.sh starts the run just after one turns). Expect 3 answered, then Kong's 429 'API rate limit exceeded' with no model call, then answered again in the next minute. Kong OSS limits requests only: there is no token or spend limit (ai-rate-limiting-advanced is enterprise).
